why: The criterion holds for the whole output. Each PASS names a wrong build it tried and says why the line catches it. Line 1 tried "upper-casing only the name (prints Hello, ADA!)" and hardcoding output for Ada; both fail because the line requires the whole greeting in upper case for any name. Line 2 tried a build that "upper-cases by default or always" or breaks name parsing; `node bin/greet.js Ada` exposes these, and so does the real 'cli' test in test/greet.test.js. The line 3 FAIL gives the concrete reason it can only be checked after merge: .github/workflows/pages.yml publishes docs/ only on push to main, so the live page still shows the old docs/index.md during review. I checked every file and behaviour cited (bin/greet.js, test/greet.test.js, pages.yml, docs/index.md) and all of them exist in the repository as described. The wrong_build entry also uses only real files.
